name: Withy Sentry
shortDescription: A basket-cutter posted where the path leaves the water.
lookDescription: A stoat sits on a cutting stool among the withies with a billhook across her knees and watches the path rather than the river.
examineDescription: A grown stoat on a cutting stool, sleeves tied back, a billhook across her knees and a woven ring on her right paw. She has been cutting withy all morning and there is a proper pile to prove it, so the posting is real work as well as a watch. She is not a student, and she will ask you what you want before she does anything else.
lockNarration: She sets the billhook down and stands up off the stool.
victoryNarration: The sentry sits back down on the stool, winded, and waves you past with the back of her paw as though you were a wasp. The spliced ring is off her paw and in the cut withy where she dropped it.
